name: hermes-mods
description: Claude Code mods built for the Hermes project: a status band above the prompt and a house-rules guard.

plugins.name: hermes-band
plugins.description: A colored band above the prompt: branch, worktree, dirty files another session touched, the context window with a hover bar and two limit gauges, the api/web dev servers with a stop-orphans button, and compact / ship / review buttons.

plugins.name: hermes-guard
plugins.description: Hermes house rules as hooks: stage by path, no code commit without a green health gate, hands-off paths behind /guard unlock, no test skips or deletes, no em-dashes in app source, subagents on Sonnet.
